name: Qingdao Foods CO.,LTD.
summary: Qingdao Foods CO.,LTD. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of biscuits and various other baked goods across the country. Its extensive product range also encompasses a diverse array of food items, including seasonings, a variety of confectionery such as chocolates and related products, peanut-based goods, red bean preparations, different types of noodles and flour ingredients, and an assortment of snack foods. The company, established in 1950, has its main operational base located in Qingdao, China.
